prompt: As of 2022, how many Indian states had any political party win more than 50% of the vote in assembly elections exactly twice?
answer:
**7 Indian states**.

Counting only assembly elections held up to 2022, seven states had exactly two instances in which a single political party secured more than 50% of the vote. This is based on the 42 such instances spread across 18 states; later elections such as Arunachal Pradesh and Sikkim in 2024 are excluded.
